learning_outcomes: Master the Distance Formula to find the length between two points.
Understand the Section Formula to find coordinates of a point dividing a line segment.
Solve CBSE/State Board HOTS questions related to coordinate geometry.
Apply logic to real-world geometric scenarios.

ai_context.learning_goal: Make abstract coordinates feel real. Use the 'Socratic Discovery Arc' to build intuition before giving formulas.
common_misconceptions: Students get confused with negative signs in the formulas.
Students struggle with the ratio in the section formula.

blocks.content: Imagine you are standing at point A and your friend is at point B on a giant grid. How do you find the exact distance between you two? Or what if you want to meet exactly halfway? This is the power of **Coordinate Geometry (निर्देशांक ज्यामिति / યામ ભૂમિતિ)**!
The Cartesian Plane: The map of mathematical reality where every point has an address (x, y).
blocks.alt_text: A glowing Cartesian plane showing the X and Y axes with a point.

blocks.content:
**Distance Formula (दूरी सूत्र):**
The distance between two points P(x₁, y₁) and Q(x₂, y₂) is given by:
**PQ = √[(x₂ - x₁)² + (y₂ - y₁)²]**

*Example:* Distance between (0,0) and (3,4) is √[(3-0)² + (4-0)²] = √(9+16) = √25 = 5 units.
💡 **Teacher's Secret:** The Distance Formula is just the Pythagorean Theorem in disguise! Draw a right triangle between the two points, and the distance is simply the hypotenuse.
The Section Formula: Finding the exact coordinate that divides a journey into specific ratios.
blocks.alt_text: A line segment divided into a ratio m1:m2 with coordinates shown.

blocks.content:
**Section Formula (विभाजन सूत्र):**
The coordinates of the point P(x, y) which divides the line segment joining the points A(x₁, y₁) and B(x₂, y₂) internally in the ratio m₁ : m₂ are:
**x = (m₁x₂ + m₂x₁) / (m₁ + m₂)**
**y = (m₁y₂ + m₂y₁) / (m₁ + m₂)**

🔥 **BOARD EXAM HOT TOPIC:** The Midpoint Formula

If the ratio is 1:1, P is the midpoint! The formula simplifies to:
**( (x₁+x₂)/2 , (y₁+y₂)/2 )**

*Board Trick:* Use k:1 ratio when you need to find the ratio itself! It makes calculations much easier.

blocks.question: The distance of the point P(2, 3) from the x-axis is
blocks.question_hi: बिंदु P(2, 3) की x-अक्ष से दूरी है
blocks.explanation: The distance of a point from the x-axis is its y-coordinate. Hence, the distance is 3 units.
blocks.explanation_hi: x-अक्ष से किसी बिंदु की दूरी उसका y-निर्देशांक होती है। इसलिए, दूरी 3 इकाई है।

blocks.question: The distance between the points A(0,6) and B(0,-2) is
blocks.question_hi: बिंदुओं A(0,6) और B(0,-2) के बीच की दूरी है

blocks.question: The distance of the point P(-6, 8) from the origin is
blocks.question_hi: बिंदु P(-6, 8) की मूल बिंदु से दूरी है

blocks.question: The coordinates of the point which lies on the y-axis at a distance of 5 units in the negative direction of y-axis are
blocks.question_hi: y-अक्ष पर y-अक्ष की ऋणात्मक दिशा में 5 इकाई की दूरी पर स्थित बिंदु के निर्देशांक हैं
blocks.explanation: Since the point lies on the y-axis, its x-coordinate is 0. Distance is 5 in negative direction, so y = -5. Point is (0, -5).
blocks.explanation_hi: चूँकि बिंदु y-अक्ष पर स्थित है, इसका x-निर्देशांक 0 है। ऋणात्मक दिशा में दूरी 5 है, इसलिए y = -5। बिंदु (0, -5) है।

blocks.question: The midpoint of the line segment joining the points A(-2, 8) and B(-6, -4) is
blocks.question_hi: बिंदुओं A(-2, 8) और B(-6, -4) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड का मध्य बिंदु है

blocks.question: The ratio in which x-axis divides the line segment joining the points (5, 4) and (2, -3) is
blocks.question_hi: वह अनुपात जिसमें x-अक्ष बिंदुओं (5, 4) और (2, -3) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड को विभाजित करता है
blocks.explanation: Let ratio be k:1. Any point on x-axis has y-coordinate 0. So, (k(-3) + 1(4))/(k+1) = 0 => -3k + 4 = 0 => k = 4/3.

blocks.question: If the points A(1, 2), B(0, 0) and C(a, b) are collinear, then
blocks.question_hi: यदि बिंदु A(1, 2), B(0, 0) और C(a, b) संरेख हैं, तो
blocks.explanation: Area of triangle is 0. 1(0 - b) + 0(b - 2) + a(2 - 0) = 0 => -b + 2a = 0 => 2a = b.

blocks.question: A point on x-axis which is equidistant from points A(2, -5) and B(-2, 9) is
blocks.question_hi: x-अक्ष पर एक बिंदु जो बिंदुओं A(2, -5) और B(-2, 9) से समदूरस्थ है

blocks.question: If A(-6, 7) and B(-1, -5) are two given points then the distance 2AB is
blocks.question_hi: यदि A(-6, 7) और B(-1, -5) दो दिए गए बिंदु हैं तो दूरी 2AB है

blocks.question: The coordinates of the centroid of a triangle whose vertices are (0, 6), (8, 12) and (8, 0) is
blocks.question_hi: एक त्रिभुज जिसके शीर्ष (0, 6), (8, 12) और (8, 0) हैं, के केंद्रक के निर्देशांक हैं

blocks.question: The distance between the points (a cosθ + b sinθ, 0) and (0, a sinθ - b cosθ) is
blocks.question_hi: बिंदुओं (a cosθ + b sinθ, 0) और (0, a sinθ - b cosθ) के बीच की दूरी है
blocks.explanation: d² = (0 - (a cosθ + b sinθ))² + (a sinθ - b cosθ - 0)² = a²cos²θ + b²sin²θ + 2ab sinθ cosθ + a²sin²θ + b²cos²θ - 2ab sinθ cosθ = a²(cos²θ + sin²θ) + b²(sin²θ + cos²θ) = a² + b². So d = √(a² + b²).
blocks.explanation_hi: d² = (0 - (a cosθ + b sinθ))² + (a sinθ - b cosθ - 0)² = a²cos²θ + b²sin²θ + 2ab sinθ cosθ + a²sin²θ + b²cos²θ - 2ab sinθ cosθ = a²(cos²θ + sin²θ) + b²(sin²θ + cos²θ) = a² + b²। इसलिए d = √(a² + b²)।

blocks.question: If the distance between the points (4, p) and (1, 0) is 5, then the value of p is
blocks.question_hi: यदि बिंदुओं (4, p) और (1, 0) के बीच की दूरी 5 है, तो p का मान है

blocks.question: A line segment is of length 10 units. If the coordinates of its one end are (2, -3) and the abscissa of the other end is 10, then its ordinate is
blocks.question_hi: एक रेखाखंड की लंबाई 10 इकाई है। यदि इसके एक सिरे के निर्देशांक (2, -3) हैं और दूसरे सिरे का भुज 10 है, तो इसकी कोटि है

blocks.question: In what ratio does the y-axis divide the line segment joining the points P(-4, 2) and Q(8, 3)?
blocks.question_hi: y-अक्ष बिंदुओं P(-4, 2) और Q(8, 3) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड को किस अनुपात में विभाजित करता है?

blocks.question: The fourth vertex D of a parallelogram ABCD whose three vertices are A(-2, 3), B(6, 7) and C(8, 3) is
blocks.question_hi: एक समांतर चतुर्भुज ABCD का चौथा शीर्ष D जिसके तीन शीर्ष A(-2, 3), B(6, 7) और C(8, 3) हैं, है
blocks.explanation: Diagonals bisect each other. Midpoint of AC = Midpoint of BD. ( (-2+8)/2, (3+3)/2 ) = ( (6+x)/2, (7+y)/2 ). (3, 3) = ((6+x)/2, (7+y)/2). 6+x=6 => x=0; 7+y=6 => y=-1. So D is (0, -1).
